name: Raycasting
summary: A ray projected from the user intersects a target for fast distal selection.
howItWorks: Point a virtual ray at an object and confirm with a button, pinch, or dwell.
advantages: Fast selection of visible distant targets.
limitations: Small and occluded targets can be difficult; precision decreases with distance.
